en-US.author: Phodal
en-US.description: AutoDev Xiuper, an AI-native, multi-agent development platform.
en-US.longDescription:
AutoDev Xiuper is an AI-native, multi-agent development platform built on Kotlin Multiplatform.
The desktop application provides AI-assisted development across the whole workflow: document research, coding, code review, data query, and artifact generation, with code-backed agents (DocumentAgent, CodingAgent, CodeReviewAgent, ChatDBAgent, ArtifactAgent), MCP tool integration, sub-agents, multi-LLM support, and tree-sitter code intelligence. The same platform ships IDE plugins, a CLI, and web and server runtimes.
en-US.name: AutoDev Desktop

zh-CN.description: AutoDev Xiuper，一个 AI 原生的多智能体开发平台。
zh-CN.longDescription:
AutoDev Xiuper 是一个基于 Kotlin Multiplatform 构建的 AI 原生多智能体开发平台。
桌面应用程序为整个开发流程提供 AI 辅助：文档调研、编码、代码评审、数据查询和产物生成，内置代码级智能体（DocumentAgent、CodingAgent、CodeReviewAgent、ChatDBAgent、ArtifactAgent），支持 MCP 工具集成、子智能体、多模型接入和 tree-sitter 代码智能。同一平台还提供 IDE 插件、CLI 以及 Web 和服务器运行时。
